Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#0 round — attraction authored as enclosure: attract pointer gathers gently inside the round (the life held before it can be faced); slow circulation 0.2; the held-possibilities formation breathes disc→ring (womb, egg, waters, uroboros named in one cycling body); the round's own outline breathes with it. Duration 12.
#1 metabolism — vortex + pulse pointer (the round's turning); auto-systole, a sine LFO on field.params.circulation ±0.18 — the round breathes; the digestive ring turns with a devourer flush (tint to #8a4a2b); the Mother's two faces walk ☾→☽ — same body, other face. Duration 11 — hunger's quicker beat.
#2 separation — repel + shove pointer (the interval opens by pushing apart); the sky ring lifts (its y extent grows — the interval in which a world can appear); the androgyne sequence disc→◘◘→disc kept from the draft with the division step tinted; light carries a weak repel (boundaries make a precinct). Duration 13.
#2b twins — line layout: the prior 0 and its halves held in a row, the arithmetic beneath; the operator sequence walks the record's own three results — (-1)/(+1) → (-1)+(+1)=0 (cancel, tint to grey) → back → (-1)-(+1)=-2 (appropriate, grey) → back — the changed operator as the scene's argument; vortex + shove (opposition's real force). Duration 10, the sharpest beat.
#3 hero — the hero walks his two emancipations as a position sequence: from between the struggles to the maternal, to the paternal, to rest above the Osiris ring (tint pales to the transformed d8d2c4); the Osiris ring opens gold; repel + shove, turbulence 0.2 (the struggle's field). Duration 13.
#4 paper — attract + implode click (writing gathers; erasure gathers the figure away); near-still field (speed 0.2, dispersion 0.02) — the sheet holds still, only the marks change; the draft's write 1 → 1/0 → 0/1 → erase sequence kept on the pale sheet with the gold capacity ring beside it. Duration 12.
#4b wheel — THE 3D SCENE. z is the unobjectified opening the wheel rolls about: En-Sof deepest (z −0.55), the refused readings (∅) behind (z −0.25), the wheel's ring at z 0 with its rotation sequence, the renewed inscription ✎ nearest the reader's hand (z +0.45); vortex3d carries the rolling, depth occlusion with night tint holds the depths; auto-roll, a sine LFO on field.params.speed — the rolling breathes. Duration 14 — the wheel takes time.
#5→0 return — ring layout: the marriage bond arranges the field; the cut-and-bond sign walks /‑ → (0/1)/(1/0) → /‑ (the cut returning as held relation); attract pointer at strength 0.15 — the bond holds without enclosing; circulation −0.3, a slow counter-turn. Duration 15, the longest beat — the return takes its time.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the journey opens with a round that encloses before the ego can represent dependence (attraction gathering inside an outline, the held possibilities breathing at its centre) and closes with a round that relates without enclosing — the marriage ring in ring layout, attraction at 0.15, and the journey's slash-signs returning transformed: #2's division, #2b's operator and #4's written 0/1 come back as (0/1)/(1/0), the same signs with changed office, the sign become Symbol again. The hunger that drove the round's first breathing (auto-systole) is answered by the wheel's auto-roll and the return's counter-turn — the breathing continues, but now the bond breathes, and the ego that could not represent its dependence begins again with the source relation visible.
Human-amplified staging: whose account is stated in the kickers and bodies where flagged (#1 samāveśa, #2 the correction, #2b the energetics-grounding, #4 the paper operation; #3's hero/avatar question human-amplified: no). Mythemic verbs only: the images perform and demonstrate the operations; no formal entailment, no historical attribution beyond the record's own.
Automation: auto-systole (#1, field.params.circulation sine — the round's breath) and auto-roll (#4b, field.params.speed sine — the wheel's rolling), both tied to the record's moves. Durations 10–15 and transitions 1.1–2.2: the twins' recognition (10s) is the sharpest beat, the wheel (14s) and the return (15s) are held longest.

Colour journey: amniotic dark (held, still pair) → the opened light (held, still pair) → struggle dark → the sheet's white → round-dark held across wheel and return (still pair). glyph_rationales.the round — enclosing outline carrying t: the serpent drawn with its tail in its mouth — the enclosing round: womb, egg, waters in one outline.
glyph_rationales.womb, egg, waters, uroboros — the held p: the dense centre of the round — the contents held together before any can be named apart.
glyph_rationales.the future ego — dependent before it can: the small bright germ at the round's edge — the centre that will distinguish, still sustained by what it will call other.
glyph_rationales.mouth and tail — eater and eaten in one: the ring breathing in its sequence — intake and expenditure, systole and diastole of one body.
glyph_rationales.the Great Mother — the giving face besid: two drawn masks side by side — the nurturing and devouring aspects of one encompassing life.
glyph_rationales.⇅: hunger — the two-way movement that keeps the round from being an inert totality.
glyph_rationales.Prajāpati's self-offering — creation as: the drawn offering fire — creation as expenditure: the world offered, the offerer transformed (p.29 lead, transmitted).
glyph_rationales.♄: Saturnine devouring — intake without renewed birth; monopoly where nourishment should renew (C26).
glyph_rationales.sky lifting from earth — the interval in: dashed sky over dotted earth with the gap between — the opened interval in which light enters and a world becomes inhabitable.
glyph_rationales.the primordial person — recognises itsel: two drawn states — the conjoined androgyne recognising itself, then the separated pair; self-recognition before sexual separation (p.105 lead).
glyph_rationales.☀: light entering — above and below, before and behind, I and you: the oriented world the separation opens.
glyph_rationales.the paśu correction — the light already: the drawn lamp already lit — prakāśa–vimarśa does not first arise when the ego takes possession; the bounded subject is a determination within appearing (C15).
glyph_rationales.≡: Māyā as operative measure — productive differentiation, dangerous when the measure conceals its dependence on the wider field (C14).
glyph_rationales.the prior 0 — their shared genesis: the wide ring holding both halves — the common ground their division denies at its peril.
glyph_rationales.Ohrmazd — the light half: the figure with upward rays — the light principal of the broken whole.
glyph_rationales.Ahriman — the dark half: the inverted figure with downward rays — the dark principal of the same broken whole.
glyph_rationales.the light half held beside its contrary: the gold disc — one valence kept in relation rather than summed away.
glyph_rationales.the dark half held beside its contrary: the umber disc — the other valence kept in relation rather than absorbed.
glyph_rationales./: the slash as division that keeps — each side retaining its sign across the relation: (-1)/(+1).
glyph_rationales.0: the acknowledged ground attended to — the sheet beside the mark.
glyph_rationales.−2: subtraction as appropriation — (-1)-(+1)=-2: one side taking the span as its own.
glyph_rationales.the hero born within the opened world: the drawn figure with raised blade — the centre formed enough to act against what formed it.
glyph_rationales.the maternal struggle — the engulfing or: a figure inside closing waves — the first emancipation: distinctness from the engulfing origin.
glyph_rationales.the paternal struggle — the arresting la: a figure before a breached wall — the second emancipation: the law that could arrest emergence addressed in turn.
glyph_rationales.the captive, the treasure, liberation —: the drawn cage with its open door and the bird away — release judged by the relation it makes possible, not possession renewed.
glyph_rationales.the Osiris transformation — death preven: the drawn sarcophagus face — death and reassembly preventing the hero's victory from becoming a permanent occupancy.
glyph_rationales.the blank sheet: the square of the page — the field on which the operation is performed.
glyph_rationales.the act performed — write, attend, inscr: the sequence writes 1, attends as 0, joins them as 0/1, then erases — the figure disappears; the capacity for appearing and distinguishing does not.
glyph_rationales.1: the first mark — determinate form on the sheet.
glyph_rationales.0/1: the joined figure — mark and ground inscribed as one determinate object, itself erasable.
glyph_rationales.the capacity that remains — not the lite: the small ring after the erasure — what can begin again; an image of the capacity, not its substance.
glyph_rationales.↺: uroboric incest versus enacted erasure — dissolution that leaves a reader able to begin again; and the sign becoming Symbol again.
glyph_rationales.the self-rolling wheel — continuing self: the drawn wheel with its off-centre hub, breathing in sequence — the round kept being made, not bestowed finished.
glyph_rationales.En-Soph — plenitude and nothingness besi: the fading dotted field — the unobjectified plenitude beside which the wheel composes itself (p.18 lead).
glyph_rationales.✎: the renewed inscription — the paper's capacity meeting the wheel's continuing composition.
glyph_rationales.the opening retained — neither perpetual: the small open ring — the unobjectified opening the winding retains; no mechanical or topological claim follows.
glyph_rationales.the shared genesis — indelible bond of t: the wide ring — even denial takes place through the field it denies; the bond of common origin.
glyph_rationales.the cut and the bond — two logics of two: two circles held across a slash — knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with (A13).
glyph_rationales.the coequal series — Name beside Power,: two columns of six marks — Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image beside Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work; formation costs what its return releases.
